rows.text: Shift counters strategically at combat with Tidus, trigger Cheer to draw cards and proliferate on damage, leverage Danny Pink for mass card draw, and overrun opponents with unblockable, counter-boosted creatures.

rows.name: Tidus, Yuna's Guardian
rows.text: at the beginning of combat on your turn, you may move a counter from target creature you control onto a second target creature you control. His Cheer ability dictates that whenever one or more creatures you control with counters on them deal combat damage to a player, you may draw a card and proliferate. Note that Tidus can move ANY counter type, including shield counters, indestructible counters from Arwen, Mortal Queen, or +1/+1 counters.

rows.name: Danny Pink
rows.text: whenever a counter is put on a creature you control, if it didn't have a counter put on it yet this turn, you draw a card. Tidus moving a counter onto a creature puts a counter on it, immediately triggering Danny Pink. Proliferating subsequently places counters on multiple creatures, drawing fresh cards for each creature modified!

rows.name: Tekuthal, Inquiry Dominus
rows.text: whenever you proliferate, proliferate an additional time instead, doubling Tidus's Cheer payoff.

rows.name: Inexorable Tide
rows.text: proliferates whenever you cast any spell.

rows.name: Evolution Sage
rows.text: proliferates on every land entry under your control.

rows.name: Sword of Truth and Justice
rows.text: grants protection from white and blue, puts a +1/+1 counter on a creature on damage, and proliferates.

rows.name: Herald of Secret Streams
rows.text: creatures you control with +1/+1 counters on them cannot be blocked, guaranteeing that your entire army connects to trigger Cheer and combat damage effects.

rows.name: Kodama of the West Tree
rows.text: modified creatures you control have trample; whenever a modified creature deals combat damage to a player, search a basic land onto the battlefield tapped.

rows.name: Kalonian Hydra
rows.text: enters with four +1/+1 counters, trample, and doubles the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control whenever it attacks.

rows.name: Sovereign Okinec Ahau
rows.text: whenever you attack, each creature you control with power greater than its base power gets a number of +1/+1 counters equal to the difference, exponentially swelling your team.

rows.name: Crystalline Crawler
rows.text: enters with +1/+1 counters, gains counters on spell casts, and removes counters to add mana of any color.

rows.name: Walking Ballista
rows.text: scales with counters and can machine-gun opposing utility creatures or direct damage to players.

guide.title: Asymmetric board wipes and counter protection

rows.name: Damning Verdict
rows.text: five-mana sorcery that destroys all creatures without counters on them, wiping opposing battlefields while leaving your entire modified board completely intact.

rows.name: Wave Goodbye
rows.text: returns each creature without a +1/+1 counter on it to its owner's hand, functioning as a one-sided board bounce.

rows.name: The Ozolith
rows.text: preserves all counters from creatures that leave the battlefield and transfers them onto target creature at beginning of combat.

rows.name: Resourceful Defense
rows.text: catches counters from permanents leaving play and lets you pay {4}{W} to move counters between any permanents at instant speed.

rows.name: Arwen, Mortal Queen
rows.text: enters with an indestructible counter and gives another creature an indestructible counter when it attacks.

rows.name: Cyclonic Rift
rows.text: premier blue reset to eliminate opposing tokens and blockers.

rows.name: Rhystic Study
rows.text: card advantage engine taxing opponents' spellcasting.

rows.name: Teferi's Protection
rows.text: phases out your board in response to mass exile or global destruction.

rows.name: Heroic Intervention
rows.text: grants hexproof and indestructible to your permanents.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares
rows.text: premier one-mana creature exile.

Keep opening hands with two to three lands, early counter producers or dorks (Birds of Paradise, Bristly Bill, Hardened Scales), and a card draw payoff (Danny Pink, Fathom Mage). Deploy Tidus on turn three, move a counter onto an unblocked attacker to guarantee Cheer combat damage, and proliferate to continuously grow your army and hand size. Deliver an unblockable alpha strike on Turn 6 or later.
House rules apply: infinite combo loops and compact wins are restricted to Turn 6 or later. Earlier turns focus on establishing board presence, counter accumulation, and combat triggers.
